name: Agent Merge
desc: Copilot watches a pull request and clears the blockers to merging.
desc_zh: Copilot 盯着一个 PR，把挡住合并的问题清掉。
solves: A pull request sits for a day on a failing check or a conflict. Agent Merge fixes them in a cloud environment and can pair with auto-merge to finish the job.
solves_zh: 一个 PR 会因为检查失败或冲突白等一天。Agent Merge 在云环境里把它们修掉，并可以和自动合并配合把整件事做完。
best_for: Your pull request is green except for CI, and you are done for the day.
best_for_zh: 你的 PR 只差 CI 一道检查没过，而你已经准备收工回家。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — GitHub Changelog, https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-agent-merge-watch）。 Already present in the GitHub Copilot app and VS Code; the 2026-10-28 change brought it into pull requests on GitHub. Paid Copilot plans. 首次公开日期来源：https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-agent-merge-watches-and-fixes-pull-requests-in-the-cloud/
